# Your Name Request is Expiring Soon

Your name request {{ nr_number }} for **{{ legal_name }}** is due to expire on {{ expiration_date }}.

If your name request expires:

* The approved name is no longer reserved for completing an application and becomes available to the public
* You will need to submit and pay for a new name request

Finish completing an application with this name before it expires. If you are not ready to completing an application yet, you can renew this name request to extend the expiry date.

---

1. Visit [BC Corporate Online]( {{ corp_online_url }})

For named businesses, once your Name Request has been approved and added to your table on this screen, you must select the "Register Now" button beside the name to begin your incorporation or registration.
  • Follow the steps in the application and complete all of the required information including addresses, contact information, people and roles, and share structure (if applicable).
  • Retain a copy of all incorporation or registration documents for your business' records.

- **Name-request approval:**
  - `isConditionallyApproved`: `stateCd === NrState.CONDITIONAL && (consentFlag === null || RECEIVED || WAIVED)`. A CONDITIONAL name request with any other consent flag is not conditionally approved, so it cannot start an incorporation or registration.
  - `isApproved`: `stateCd === NrState.APPROVED`.
  - `enableIncorporation`: approved or conditionally approved, and some `action.filingName` is `LearFilingTypes.INCORPORATION` or `LearFilingTypes.REGISTRATION`.
  - Applicant email and phone come from `applicants[0]`, else `null`.

- Org creation, membership updates and invitation accept all commit part-way. A later failure (pay-api, Keycloak, mailer, task creation) leaves earlier writes with no rollback.
- A mailer failure on `create_affiliation_invitation` leaves the invitation saved. A retry then fails with `DATA_ALREADY_EXISTS` (the duplicate-invitation check), so the user cannot simply re-create it.
- `update_membership` checks 3 to 5 run after setattr, so a refusal may leave state changed.
- Deleting an affiliation invitation that is ACCEPTED only marks it deleted, so the duplicate check on invitations may still see it, depending on `find_invitations_by_org_entity_ids` (behaviour not in this topic).
- `Flags.init_app` in production without a key leaves no client. `is_on` and `value` silently return defaults.

- **`BC-IA-PAID`**
  - `header.isFutureEffective` -> "On the effective date and time you specified..."; otherwise "Once your filing has been processed...".
  - `legalType == 'CP'` -> Incorporation Certificate, Certified Rules, Certified Memorandum.
  - `legalType != 'CP'` -> Notice of Articles, Incorporation Certificate.
  - It attaches the incorporation application and the receipt.
- **`BC-IA-COMPLETED`**
  - `legalType == 'CP'` -> Incorporation Certificate, Certified Rules, Certified Memorandum.
  - Otherwise -> Notice of Articles, Incorporation Certificate. It includes the CRA notice.

- No `nameRequest.nrNumber` -> "A company name using the Incorporation Number will be provided on the Recognition Date and Time."
- `nrNumber` present -> `nameRequest.legalName`.
- `listOfTranslations|length > 0` -> table of `name|upper`.

**`incorporation-application/completingParty.html`**

- `if incorporationApplication and PAID -> business is taken from nameRequest and identifier = filing.temp_reg`.
- Alteration recipients:
  - `if filing_type == 'alteration' and filing.submitter_roles and UserRoles.staff in filing.submitter_roles -> add header.documentOptionalEmail`.
  - `if alteration and not staff -> add get_user_email_from_auth(...)`.
- `if not recipients -> return {}`.
- `get_additional_info(filing)` returns `{nameChange: 'toLegalName' in meta_data_alteration}` for an alteration, and `{}` otherwise.

## Hazards

- A failed deletion is not detected before the dashboard navigates in `confirmDeleteApplication`, so the user can leave the page while the draft still exists.
- The `loadChangeOfAddress` condition differs between its two descriptions (`changeOfAddress` checked or not).
- The authorization PATCH action is derived only from `isAuthorized`. The error dialog is the only feedback.
- `getCountryName` errors are not handled.
- A missing `officer.firstName` and `organizationName` gives an empty name and avatar.
- The polling timer can leave `inProcessFiling` unset after timeout with no reload.
